summary: DNA X, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision that it regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(1) (minimum $2.5M stockholders' equity) as of August 28, 2026. The company remains subject to delisting if it fails to maintain compliance with all Nasdaq rules until November 18, 2026, and will be under a mandatory panel monitor until August 28, 2027. If non-compliant again during monitoring, no cure period applies; delisting determination may follow. Risk-arb angle: monitor ongoing compliance, potential Nasdaq delisting.
